headline: Scotch Whisky Shipments to India Face Regulatory Laboratory Testing Hurdles
summary: Despite India reducing import tariffs on Scotch whisky to 75%, bulk shipments face delays due to mandatory food safety testing and a customs investigation regarding Diageo and Pernod Ricard.
why: Non-tariff trade barriers and customs audits can impede market access gains for international beverage corporations in high-growth emerging consumer markets.
